page.title: Portals by keyboard
page.lead: Walk with WASD or the arrows to a building and press E. In the window, choose with the keyboard only: the item number, ←/→ to change page, ↑/↓ and Enter, Home and End. Esc closes.

prompt.enter: {building}: press E or tap to enter

list.hint: Numbers 1–9 and 0 choose · ←/→ page · ↑/↓ and Enter · Home/End

portal.coursesIntro: Choose the course to go to its city.

enrollment.intro: Enroll in a course. The number does what the course button does.
enrollment.codeHint: In the demo, the code is {code}. Esc goes back to the list.
enrollment.codeWrong: Wrong code. Check it and try again.
